description: A plain-language question about the public sample audit or a published vendor's score, answered from that data only: numbers copied with their intervals and tier, every claim cited (verdict fields, finding ids, evidence ids), "not in the data" instead of a guess. Requests for advice on raising a score, and for private data (brand names, source ids), are refused.

vendor.description: A published vendor's profile slug, e.g. "acme-ai-resolve-bot". Omit for the public sample audit (synthetic demo data, labelled as such).
